SELECT
    c.code AS currency,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) AS postings,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM (
    SELECT
        txn_id,
        external_ref,
        account_id,
        currency,
        amount,
        posted_at,
        value_date,
        reversal_of,
        loaded_at,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY external_ref ORDER BY loaded_at) AS rn
    FROM transactions
) t
JOIN currencies c ON c.code = t.currency
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY c.code;

WITH cad_txns AS (
    SELECT
        (posted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto')::date AS toronto_date,
        amount
    FROM transactions
    WHERE currency = 'CAD'
)
SELECT
    toronto_date,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM cad_txns
GROUP BY toronto_date
ORDER BY toronto_date;

SELECT c.code AS currency,
       COUNT(t.txn_id) FILTER (WHERE scale(t.amount) > c.minor_units) AS bad_rows
FROM currencies c
LEFT JOIN transactions t
  ON t.currency = c.code
GROUP BY c.code, c.minor_units;

SELECT t.txn_id
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.reversal_of IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM transactions t2
        WHERE t2.txn_id = t.reversal_of
          AND t2.account_id = t.account_id
          AND t2.currency = t.currency
          AND t2.amount = -t.amount
    );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.txn_id) AS reversed_count
FROM transactions t1
JOIN transactions t2
  ON t2.reversal_of = t1.txn_id
 AND t2.account_id = t1.account_id
 AND t2.currency = t1.currency
 AND t2.amount = -t1.amount;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS not_reversed
FROM transactions t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions r
    WHERE r.reversal_of = t.txn_id
);

SELECT r.report_date,
       COUNT(t.txn_id) AS late_rows,
       SUM(t.amount) AS late_amount
FROM report_runs r
JOIN transactions t
  ON t.value_date = r.report_date
 AND t.loaded_at > r.generated_at
GROUP BY r.report_date;

SELECT
    r.report_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.currency = 'CAD' AND t.loaded_at <= r.generated_at THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS reported_total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.currency = 'CAD' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS corrected_total
FROM report_runs r
JOIN transactions t ON t.value_date = r.report_date
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM transactions t2
    WHERE t2.value_date = r.report_date
      AND t2.loaded_at > r.generated_at
)
GROUP BY r.report_date;

SELECT c.code AS currency,
       SUM(ROUND(t.amount, c.minor_units)) AS rounded_total
FROM currencies c
JOIN transactions t ON t.currency = c.code
GROUP BY c.code;

SELECT DATE(t.posted_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') AS toronto_date,
       SUM(t.amount) AS net_amount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.external_ref) t.txn_id, t.external_ref, t.account_id, t.currency, t.amount, t.posted_at, t.loaded_at
    FROM transactions t
    JOIN currencies c ON c.code = t.currency
    WHERE c.code = 'CAD'
    ORDER BY t.external_ref, t.loaded_at
) t
GROUP BY toronto_date
ORDER BY toronto_date;
